children: Red Robin completed the sale of 108 company-owned restaurants for $89.4 million in gross proceeds. The casual dining chain says the transactions with three experienced multi-unit operators will help strengthen its balance sheet and support debt refinancing. Eight additional restaurants are expected to close by fiscal year end, bringing total proceeds to approximately $96 million from 116 units sold. The company says it plans to use the net proceeds to pay down outstanding debt.
